description: Creates a new page in the user's Webcake account from a page source { page, popup, settings, options, cartConfigs }, saves it, and then publishes it (builds the rendered app on the Webcake build host and publishes it through the editor's publish route) so its preview renders; publish:false skips publishing, and a failed publish does not fail the create (result.publish reports the outcome). Before validating it applies deterministic layout corrections (off-canvas boxes, elements below wrapped text, containers grown to fit) and lists them in auto_fixed. External images and self-hosted font files in the source are re-hosted on Webcake's CDN during the save. dry_run defaults to true: it validates, caches the source under a draft_id, and returns the request it would send with the token masked; dry_run:false performs the create. A draft_id (from a validation failure, dry run, or timed-out create) re-runs from the cached source. Organization: explicit organization_id ('personal' = no organization), then WEBCAKE_ORG_ID / x-webcake-org-id, then automatic — no organizations → personal, exactly one → selected (organization_auto_selected:true), two or more → ok:false with the organization list. A page without a custom domain has a preview link that renders for about 10 minutes after each publish. Requires Webcake credentials.

draft_id.description: A draft_id from a previous create_page call (validation failure, dry_run=true, or a timed-out/failed create). Loads the cached source, so the full JSON is not re-sent; covers the dry-run → real call step, fixes after errors, and retries after a timeout.

dry_run.description: Default TRUE — validate, cache the source as draft_id, and preview the request without sending. Set false to actually create.

organization_id.description: Organization to create the page in (an organization id). The string 'personal' saves without any organization and skips auto-resolution. When omitted: WEBCAKE_ORG_ID / x-webcake-org-id, else automatic — one organization is selected, two or more return the list (ok:false), none means personal.

publish.description: Default TRUE — after a successful create, automatically build the rendered app and publish (publish_html) so the preview renders immediately. Set false to create source-only (blank preview until publish_page runs).

source.description: Page source { page, popup, settings, options, cartConfigs } (object or JSON string). Required unless draft_id is given. Elements may be sparse — id, type, responsive.<bp>.styles for both breakpoints, specials and real events; omitted properties/runtime/empty events and children/per-breakpoint config are filled from factory defaults (full nodes also work).

name: create_page
